seeded.note: Candidates seeded from a research agent's web-search summaries (see data/leads); unverified until the contest file cites the Secretary of State certified list. No stance questions set yet. Research notes: Names as shown on the SoS results page. The SoS districtwide results page (snippet; labeled unofficial, to be certified by July 10, 2026) shows Rivas 51.1% (62,043), Dueñas (DEM) 24.9% (30,240), and Rudy Melendez (REP) 24.0% (29,193). The margin for second place was about 1,000 votes, and the final certified order was NOT confirmed from the certified list. AP items say both Rivas and Dueñas advanced; dates were not shown, and both also advanced in a prior cycle (2022 for Dueñas), but the 2026 field and the SoS figures fit. The LA Almanac labels Rivas a majority winner, but top-two still sends two candidates to November. A Westfield voter guide names Benito Bernal (R), the 2024 opponent; this looks stale. A Green Party elections site lists a 2018 Dueñas congressional run; her party registration in 2018 was not verified. Melendez's primary-list designation (Organized Labor Advocate) appears in an LA County primary list snippet; this is irrelevant if he did not advance. Incumbent means the current member for district number 29; Prop 50 redrew the boundaries. Biographical research is incomplete because the web-search budget ran out.
